summary: Episodes 1-17 of the 2020 remake adapt manga chapters 1-60 linearly at ~3.5 chapters/episode with zero filler. dragonquest.fandom carries a complete per-episode 'adapted chapters' field AND the reverse mapping on every chapter page (1-60 walked); the two directions agree everywhere. Wikipedia's volume/chapter-title list independently corroborates most boundaries via namesake titles (ep5=ch12 'The Insignia of Avan', ep9=ch27 'A Fragment of Courage!', ep10=ch32 'Aim for Papnica!', ep14=ch50 'Cruelty! Flazzard', ep16=ch54/55 Matoriv chapters, ep17=ch59 'Immortal Saviour!!!'). Only structural quirks: ep1 grafts prologue material from chs 99/183 (partials) plus a 1-panel sliver of ch6 ahead of its mainline ch1-3 coverage, and part of ch17 is re-used in ep7. Several chapter splits straddle episode boundaries (3, 6, 8, 12, 15, 20, 31, 35, 44, 54, 57, 60); START values follow the majority/bulk rule with the split noted per anchor.

structure.notes: Single continuous 100-episode season (AniList 114099), fully linear manga adaptation, no filler; eps 1-17 run ~3.5 chapters/episode covering chs 1-60 (vols 1-7). Fandom forward mapping (episode pages, '|adapted=' field) and reverse mapping (chapter pages 1-60, '|adapted= 2020: episode N') agree on every episode; Wikipedia's volume list corroborates via namesake chapter titles and the v1-v7 boundaries (48->v6, 57->v7 land exactly on ep 14 and ep 16/17 anchors). Fandom also has a recap page 'episode 37.5' — a recap special outside OUR 1-100 numbering and outside this target range; no numbering conversion needed (fandom 2020 episode numbers = OUR cumulative numbers). Existing ep100->349 anchor untouched.

flags_for_sean: dragonquest.fandom is the only per-episode chapter source for this range; forward (episode pages) and reverse (chapter pages) mappings are the same wiki, so true independence rests on Wikipedia chapter-title/volume-boundary correlation (strong for eps 3-6, 8-12, 14-17). No external source disputes anything.

Split-chapter START calls (chs 8, 20, 35, 54, 57) use the bulk rule from chapter-page credits and per-episode chapter load; ch-42 fandom page lacks an adapted field but ep-12's page lists it (no conflict).
